$comment: Card art for the Firefly custom pack (src/data/custom/firefly.json): one source per `art` key. `commons:` files are freely licensed (credit shown on the card); `enwiki:`, `tmdb:` and `file:` (saved under vendor/custom/firefly/) (TMDB image ids) are non-free stills from the series, used locally only. Nothing here is downloaded into git: `npm run custom-cards` fetches into vendor/custom/ and renders into public/custom/. Drop your own image as vendor/custom/firefly/override/<key>.<jpg|png|webp> to replace one.

mal.subject: Captain Malcolm Reynolds, a rugged ex-soldier in his thirties: brown duster coat over a dark red shirt and suspenders, wry half-smile, the cargo bay of his ship softly blurred behind him

serenity.subject: the Firefly-class transport ship Serenity in flight: bulbous bird-like bow, long body, two rotating side engines glowing amber, a worn and patched hull, cruising past a dusty frontier planet

river.subject: River Tam, a slight young woman with long dark wavy hair, eerie distant stare, face half in shadow, hints of psychic static crackling in the air around her

simon.subject: Dr. Simon Tam, a neat young surgeon in a waistcoat and pressed shirt, earnest and protective, a medical kit at hand in the ship's infirmary
simon.notes: Simon faces the viewer in a three-quarter view, looking at the viewer, his face large, well lit and in sharp focus (eyes at about 40 % from the top); calm and composed, no gun, no blood

book.subject: Shepherd Book, an older preacher with a calm face and wild grey hair tied back, high-collared dark shepherd's clothes, a small bible in hand, a hint of a dangerous past

mr-universe.subject: Mr. Universe, an excitable tech genius surrounded by dozens of glowing screens and antennae in a cluttered broadcast lair on a lonely moon

miranda.subject: Miranda, a hazy, silent colony world: empty city towers under an amber-grey sky, an unsettling stillness, seen from orbit through a thin atmosphere

vera.subject: Vera, a huge customised long rifle (a full-bore auto-lock with a big scope) displayed like a prized possession, lying on a crate in a dim cargo bay

lassiter.source: commons:File:Flintlock pistol, 1790-1820 - Wisconsin Historical Museum - DSC03273.JPG
lassiter.subject: the Lassiter, a priceless antique laser pistol with an ornate brass-and-wood grip, displayed on velvet in a rich collector's case

skyplex.source: commons:File:International Space Station after undocking of STS-132.jpg
skyplex.search: International Space Station after undocking STS-132
skyplex.subject: Niska's skyplex: a huge, ugly orbital crime-lord fortress built from rusted industrial modules — a dark central tower with stacked ring platforms, girders and spikes, rows of red-lit windows, small freighters docked at its arms — hanging menacingly over a hazy amber planet

inara.subject: Inara Serra, an elegant Companion with long dark curls, silk robes in deep reds and gold, poised and composed in her lavishly draped shuttle

shuttle.source: commons:File:The SpaceX Crew Dragon Endeavour approaches the International Space Station (iss065e002708).jpg
shuttle.subject: one of Serenity's short-range shuttles: a compact, rounded, slightly wedge-shaped craft in worn cream and rust plating, a wide curved front window glowing with warm lantern light and silk curtains, small thruster pods underneath, just undocking from the side of the larger Firefly-class transport whose battered hull fills the background

badger.subject: Badger, a small-time crime boss in a bowler hat and shabby suit, smug grin, sitting behind a desk in a dingy back-room office on a dock world
badger.notes: light Badger's face clearly and evenly with a warm key light from the front-left and a soft fill: no hard shadow from the bowler hat's brim over his eyes, eyes and smirk fully visible, face the brightest part of the image

saffron.subject: Saffron, a con artist with red hair, innocent smile and a hidden knife behind her back, framed in a doorway of a spaceship

reavers.subject: Reavers, savage scarred raiders whose ship has no engine core containment: a jagged, blood-red rust-streaked ship looming out of darkness

into-the-black.subject: a small battered transport ship flying through a glittering asteroid field toward a far nebula, vast deep space ahead

signing-on.subject: a mismatched ship's crew of nine standing together in a cargo bay: captain in duster, soldier, pilot, mechanic in coveralls, mercenary, doctor, preacher, companion, and a girl

take-the-job.subject: a burly mercenary in a wide hat herding cattle onto a ramp at a dusty frontier town, a spaceship parked behind

misbehave.subject: a ship's captain and two crew drawing pistols and rifles in a smoky cargo bay, ready for a fight

alliance.subject: a vast gleaming grey Alliance cruiser with its searchlights sweeping, closing in from above on a tiny transport ship

persephone.source: commons:File:Two wharf boats at the St. Louis levee with a steamboat docked at the nearer one. - DPLA - 1d3d6e6c0b8b3a1e2b0b6d8e0b4c0b9f.jpg
persephone.search: Two wharf boats at the St. Louis levee with a steamboat docked
persephone.subject: Eavesdown Docks on a dusty frontier world: crowded market stalls, cargo crates, ships landing, lanterns, a busy space-western port

zoe.subject: Zoe Washburne, a tall, composed first mate and veteran soldier in a leather vest, holding a short lever-action carbine, steady and fearless

wash.subject: Hoban 'Wash' Washburne, a cheerful pilot in a loud Hawaiian shirt with plastic dinosaur toys on the console, grinning at the controls

kaylee.subject: Kaylee Frye, a bubbly young ship's mechanic in grease-stained coveralls with a flower-print shirt, wrench in hand, beaming in the engine room

jayne.subject: Jayne Cobb, a hulking mercenary with a goatee in a grey t-shirt, cradling a huge revolver, scowling and dangerous
